entries.zh: 建功；因所做之事而得的功劳、功绩
entries.en: merit earned by a deed; to establish merit

entries.zh: 月；月份
entries.en: month
entries.notes: M 栏「gue juǎn」第二音节未解，L 与 H 均指「月」，释义从之

entries.zh: 月日（月份与日子；亦指月数、月龄）
entries.en: month and day; months (a span of months)

entries.zh: 正月；一年的第一个月
entries.en: the first month of the year

entries.zh: 正月；一年的头一个月
entries.en: the first month of the year (first lunar month)

entries.zh: 卯月；农历第二个月
entries.en: the second month of the year (mao month, the second lunar month)

entries.zh: 产后头一个月；坐月子之月
entries.en: the first month after childbirth; the lying-in month

entries.zh: 临产之月；预产月份
entries.en: the month in which a woman is due to give birth

entries.zh: 一年的后六个月；下半年
entries.en: the last six months of the year; the second half of the year
entries.notes: H 栏首字标[疑:稔]，而 M「ǔn」合于「穩」不合「稔」，释义依 L 栏「后六个月」

entries.zh: 桌；桌子
entries.en: table

entries.zh: 席；坐席（铺席的坐处，亦指宴席）
entries.en: mat; seating mat; banquet seat (feast)
entries.notes: M 栏第二音节「sjědra」未解，H「席」与 mesa 仅部分相合

entries.zh: 台；承放物品的高台、案台
entries.en: table; raised stand or platform
entries.notes: M 栏末附「altor」（疑西语 altar，祭台）注记，未能确定其为释义抑或对音

entries.zh: 索（绳索）
entries.en: rope, cord
entries.notes: L 栏作「mesa」而 H 栏「索」为绳索、M 栏「va ĩ」不可解，四栏不合，疑原件串行或讹写

entries.zh: 几；小桌、几案
entries.en: small table; side table

entries.zh: 八仙桌；可坐八人的方桌
entries.en: square table for eight (baxian table)

entries.zh: 摆放不当的桌子；位置不佳、放得不正的桌
entries.en: a table badly placed; a table set in an improper position
entries.notes: L 栏「Señerea」拼写残损，H「棹露不自在」非常语，依「mal puesta」定其义

entries.zh: 桌柜；带抽屉的桌子
entries.en: table with drawers; cabinet table
entries.notes: M 栏声调记号污损（T99），然 L、H、M 三栏字义一致，仅调号不可辨

entries.zh: 灵桌；灵前的供桌
entries.en: table set before the deceased; funeral offering table

entries.zh: 祭桌；祭祀、供神用的桌子
entries.en: altar table; offering table
entries.notes: H 栏首字「索」与 altar 义不合，疑为「案」之讹写，M「va to」未能确证

entries.zh: 筵席桌；摆了菜肴的桌子
entries.en: table spread with dishes; banquet table
entries.notes: M 栏「l to iŋ」含缩写与未解音节，依 L「mesa con manjar」与 H「棹席」定筵席义
